problem: B2B ads cannot be targeted to named contacts or show which accounts saw them; Vector offers contact-level ad targeting and relationship intelligence.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs identity resolution and ad-platform integrations at contact level; standard data engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Depends on data partnerships and ad platforms; established B2B ad vendors could replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbents copying or buying Vector.

market_need_then: No dated source collected; founders came from Drift's sales organisation, which sells to the same marketing buyers.

brand_strength.rationale: No source found about the brand itself; rated low-middle by default because nothing shows it drove growth.

outcome_analysis: Vector, a 2022 Boston company from Winter 2023, was run by two former Drift sales-engineering leaders and raised a US$10M Series A in May 2026 led by SignalFire and HubSpot Ventures. The long gap from YC to Series A suggests slow, capital-light growth; revenue and customer data are not public (an aggregator revenue estimate is unreliable).
notes: Series A cross-checked: company blog, Pulse 2.0 and Martech360 (May 2026); SignalFire page dated 2026-06-29 conflicts. A US$500K pre-seed from YC appears only on aggregators (Employbl/Diffbot, CB Insights) and is unverified, so not recorded. 'Generic' name problem is my judgment of the common word, not sourced; remove if disputed. No competitors dated near early 2023 found. No layoffs or shutdown found.
